## Faunisticke ctverce pro Prerov {#sec-about}

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show the code"
#| 
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(RCzechia)
library(tidyverse)

# katastr Prerov
Prerov <- RCzechia::obce_polygony() %>%
  filter(NAZ_OBEC == "Přerov")

# faunisticke ctverce (male = cislo s pismenem)
sq.Prerov.high <- st_join(KFME_grid("high"), Prerov, left = F)

# extra detailni deleni ctvercu 
sq.Prerov.aaaa <- st_make_grid(sq.Prerov.high, n = c(24, 24))

# interaktivni mapa
# seda = katastr Prerov
# cervena = detailni ctverce
# modra = male faunisticke ctverce, kliknutim se zobrazi cislo
leaflet(data = republika("low")) %>% 
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") %>% 
  addPolygons(data = Prerov, color = "gray", weight = 1, fillOpacity = 0) %>% 
  addPolygons(data = sq.Prerov.aaaa, color = "red", weight = 1, fillOpacity = 0) %>% 
  addPolygons(data = sq.Prerov.high, color = "blue", weight = 1, fillOpacity = 0, popup = ~as.character(ctverec)) %>%
  leaflet.extras::addResetMapButton()
```
